title: Plan: Asteroid ephemeris support
description:
Study + decompose asteroid ephemeris support into implement sub-tasks (mirror how swisseph-rs/13 decomposed PNOC into 82–90). Produce any needed C ref docs via dedicated sonnet agents per the c_source_budget protocol before planning; the planner does not read C source directly.

## Why this exists
Asteroids were a definite oversight in the original phase plan (task 13) — no task ever added asteroid *position* computation. Surfaced during review of swisseph-rs/83 (phenomena): pheno's Bowell §5k magnitude branch and MAG_ELEM rows 15–20 are dead because no backend can compute Ceres..Vesta, so the pheno golden battery had to drop Ceres (shipped 120 cases, not the spec'd 132).

## Current state — half-built (verify all before planning)
- **Type layer PRESENT**: `Body::Ceres/Pallas/Juno/Vesta` (raw ids 17–20), `Body::Asteroid(AsteroidId)` with AST_OFFSET encode/decode (src/types.rs:100-107, 156).
- **.se1 file-format layer PRESENT**: `seas*` → `FileType::MainAsteroid`, individual asteroid files → `FileType::Asteroid` with the 4th MPC-elements text line parsed (src/sweph_file/mod.rs:64, parse.rs:105-108, 158-176). The format layer can READ an asteroid file.
- **Calc dispatch ABSENT**: `calc_body_moshier/sweph/jpl` (src/context.rs:766/795/846) match only Sun/Moon/Mercury..Pluto; everything else → `Err(EphemerisNotAvailable)`. No asteroid branch, and `Ephemeris::new` (context.rs:22) only loads `planet_files` + `moon_files` — asteroid files are never opened.
- **Metadata plumbing ABSENT**: the C `swed.ast_H/ast_G/ast_diam` globals (from SE1 asteroid-file loads) are stubbed in TWO places today — `phenomena.rs` §5k (returns EphemerisNotAvailable for numbered asteroids) and `eclipse::body_radius_au`. Both should consume the same threaded config once it exists.

## Scope to decompose (indicative — refine during study)
1. Config/loading: open seas + individual-asteroid `.se1` files in `Ephemeris::new`; thread ast_H/ast_G/ast_diam metadata into config (stateless — no globals).
2. Backend dispatch: asteroid branches in calc_body_sweph (main path — asteroids are SE1-only; Moshier/JPL have no asteroid ephemeris, so decide the fallback/error behavior and match C). Main asteroids (Ceres..Vesta, ids 17–20) vs numbered asteroids (AST_OFFSET+n).
3. File selection: find_file / segment path for asteroid ipli ranges (SE_PLMOON_OFFSET..SE_AST_OFFSET boundary handling already partly in parse.rs:176).
4. Consume the new metadata in phenomena §5k (Bowell H-G) and eclipse::body_radius_au — remove both stubs.
5. Golden coverage: asteroid positions (Ceres..Vesta + a numbered asteroid) across epochs/flags; and the deferred **Ceres pheno coverage** re-enabling the §5k branch (the swisseph-rs/83 follow-up folds in here).

## Sequencing
Implement wave runs AFTER the PNOC implement tasks (84–90) land, and before Heliacal (~14). Wire implement sub-tasks' deps against 84–90 at decomposition time if a real code-path dependency exists. This arc blocks swisseph-rs/15 (Public API / docs / feature flags) — asteroids must exist before the public surface is finalized.

## C source reference
- swecl.c asteroid magnitude (Bowell) already mapped in docs/c-ref-phenomena.md §5k
- SE1 asteroid file handling: sweph.c sweph()/sweph_asteroid paths, catalogue-internal (asteroid file loading, ast_H/ast_G/ast_diam population)

edges.note: Public API / docs / feature flags must not finalize before asteroid support exists (asteroid arc ~16 blocks the wrap-up).
